name: ZARP Stablecoin
oneLiner: ZARP is a centralized South African Rand stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against ZAR cash reserves held in treasury at Old Mutual Wealth.
collateral: South African rand cash reserves held 1:1 in a treasury managed by Old Mutual Wealth, independently audited by Kempen Audit
pegMechanism: Mint/burn 1:1 with ZAR through ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd issuing partners; reserves may not be used for any purpose other than redemption

sources.label: Kempen ZARP agreed-upon procedures report - February 2026

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ZARP issues its token natively on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Solana; per-chain mint/admin roles resolve to ZARP-controlled EOAs (mint-authority review 2026-07-15). No third-party bridge carries the representation.

mintAuthority.summary: ZARP exposes AccessControl MINTER_ROLE minting. Enumerated via RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events and confirmed via hasRole: MINTER_ROLE = 0x37b1af (EOA), DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0xf50064 (EOA), UPGRADER_ROLE currently held by no one (all grants revoked). Consistent across Ethereum, Base, Polygon. Solana mintAuthority = system-owned wallet (EOA-equivalent), same address on the current Solana mint.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x37b1af...) = true; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). RoleGranted events confirmed this address received MINTER_ROLE; no corresponding RoleRevoked. hasRole confirmed true on Base and Polygon at same address.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xf50064...) = true; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). RoleGranted event at genesis plus transfer confirmed. hasRole also true on Base and Polygon.

controls.label: ZARP Solana mint authority (both mints)
controls.evidence: Solana getAccountInfo on both ZARP SPL mints (dngKhBQ... and 8v8aBHR...) returned mintAuthority = 797qLH2ZBvMrroZwxsLiWxgvDeLfUeJaHL1xWjfC7J4j. Account owner_program = 11111111111111111111111111111111 (System Program) = EOA-equivalent wallet, not a program.

review.evidence: Role enumeration via Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events plus hasRole confirmation at block 25295023. MINTER_ROLE = one EOA (0x37b1af), DEFAULT_ADMIN = one EOA (0xf50064), UPGRADER_ROLE = nobody currently (prior holder 0xfa4eb9 had all roles revoked). Same MINTER and ADMIN confirmed on Base and Polygon. Solana both SPL mints share one system-wallet mintAuthority. All addressable controls confirmed. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Kempen Audit issued quarterly agreed-upon-procedures reports through 2026-02-27, published 2026-03-03, but the next expected quarterly report is overdue as of 2026-07-15; current recurring reconciliation is therefore not established. No exact prudential issuer authorization for ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd was established in FSCA's crypto-asset provider records.

reserves.name: ZAR fiat reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd.; Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company; Standard Bank

reserveReview.rationale: The live single-asset adapter publishes one aggregate ZAR fiat reserves row, so the reviewed classification is keyed to that exact 100% identity. ZARP's documentation states that each token represents one rand supported by a treasury of actual rand currency equivalents. Kempen's February 2026 agreed-upon procedures verified balances in an Old Mutual Wealth trust account and ZARP's Standard Bank call-deposit/current accounts and reconciled liabilities across Ethereum, Solana, Base, and Polygon. The report does not establish a redemption settlement time or a complete cash-versus-cash-equivalent split. Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Kempen AUP PDF still verifies ZAR collateral in Standard Bank + Old Mutual Wealth accounts totaling R87,291,970 against issued ZARP on 27 Feb 2026; ZARP docs introduction still states treasury reserve of rand currency equivalents managed by Old Mutual Wealth.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: ZARP treasury and Kempen reserve-assurance disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve is identified as rand currency equivalents, but the reviewed sources do not provide a current bank-account or cash-equivalent category split, provider shares, or legal segregation terms.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Rand bank balances are external reserve assets rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: The Standard Bank of South Africa

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kempen verified the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and ZARP Standard Bank accounts, while management states that reserve funds are free of other debts, liens, and encumbrances and reserved exclusively for redemption. The materials do not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or a redemption settlement time.
